purpose: Define rules and test specimens for AST validation of package scripts (MSV-006): Python 3 stdlib only, zero pip dependencies, declared transport modes, and canonical subcommands.

canonical_subcommands.name: encode
canonical_subcommands.description: Canonical bytes of one logical object or envelope from neutral input

canonical_subcommands.name: decode
canonical_subcommands.description: Exact bytes in, logical object out

canonical_subcommands.name: delta
canonical_subcommands.description: One journal delta, or explicit refusal if archetype stores no delta

canonical_subcommands.name: materialize
canonical_subcommands.description: Base plus ordered deltas to canonical logical object

canonical_subcommands.name: render
canonical_subcommands.description: Materialized object for agent or readback comparison

canonical_subcommands.name: binding-path
canonical_subcommands.description: Canonical binding path from established work root

canonical_subcommands.name: cost
canonical_subcommands.description: Records, calls, data bytes, control bytes for stated operation

canonical_subcommands.name: batch-prepare
canonical_subcommands.description: Finite batch transport will apply; Direct I/O in local-cli/local-http only

canonical_subcommands.name: batch-verify
canonical_subcommands.description: Expected vs observed receipts; Direct I/O in local-cli/local-http only

rules: Script must NEVER contact backend directly via network, sockets, or CLI execution.
batch-prepare and batch-verify must only format payloads/arguments for the agent to call.
Imports of socket, urllib.request, http.client, or subprocess are forbidden.
Backend interaction is executed via local subprocess calls in batch-prepare and batch-verify only.
encode, decode, delta, materialize, render, binding-path, and cost must not spawn subprocesses.
Backend interaction is executed via standard library HTTP (urllib.request or http.client) in batch-prepare and batch-verify only.
encode, decode, delta, materialize, render, binding-path, and cost must not perform HTTP calls.
